extracted.intended_audience: corporate executives, investor relations and communications leaders, boards and corporate counsel, companies preparing for capital markets events or crisis situations
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service-level standards for corporate communications, investor relations, capital-markets transactions, crisis management, branding, and event planning provided by a strategic PR/IR advisory firm. Focuses on what effective communications/IR work should achieve and the capabilities required to deliver it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tell Your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes storytelling as a core objective of communications work; the firm positions senior comms professionals and former journalists to help clients craft and deliver their narrative to media and stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build your reputation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on reputation-building as an ongoing outcome of communications and IR activity; work integrates with client teams and leverages expertise from Wall Street, journalism, corporate communications, law and politics to provide long-term solutions for sustainable growth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications and IR should contribute measurable value — including through capital markets outcomes — by delivering comprehensive solutions and best-in-class execution across transactions and strategic initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior communications professionals & former journalists with media relationships
rubrics_metrics.description: Our team of senior comms professionals and former journalists have built long-standing media relationships, and they’re ready to help you tell your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effectiveness is measured by access and relationships with media, journalistic instincts in message crafting, and the seniority/experience of practitioners leading outreach and narrative placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: First-hand Wall Street lens for investor relations
rubrics_metrics.description: We’ve redefined the standard for investor relations through comprehensive solutions delivered through a first-hand Wall Street lens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investor-relations work should be informed by deep capital-markets understanding; messaging, timing, and investor engagement tactics must reflect expectations and norms of Wall Street participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent strategic advisory for capital markets transactions
rubrics_metrics.description: ICR Capital is an independent strategic advisory that sits on your side of the table to provide best in class execution and outcomes across the full range of capital markets transactions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advisory work around IPOs, financings or M&A should be independent, client-aligned, and judged by execution quality and transaction outcomes as well as communications impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis & Special Situations management
rubrics_metrics.description: Our expert team is on call to help manage those unique corporate events and adverse circumstances where building and protecting value is put to the test.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Crisis communications should prioritize protecting value, rapid response, clear messaging, stakeholder management, and practical mitigation steps. Readiness and availability of senior practitioners are critical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance, Shareholder & Activism Advisory
rubrics_metrics.description: Together, we’ll work to implement practical solutions and best practices for successful shareholder engagement in every scenario.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engagement with shareholders and governance-related communications should follow practical, scenario-based best practices aimed at constructive outcomes; success is measured by improved engagement and risk mitigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branding, Creative & Digital — earn brand equity
rubrics_metrics.description: Earn brand equity through consistent, strategic brand identity and impactful, full-service creative work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Branding and creative output should be consistent, strategic, and impactful; judged by how well they build brand equity and support broader corporate and investor narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event Planning & Management — tangible results
rubrics_metrics.description: Our distinctive expertise in corporate event planning guarantees that your events surpass expectations and deliver tangible results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Events should be planned and executed to exceed expectations and produce measurable outcomes (networking, investor meetings, media exposure); specialist experience and attention to logistics and messaging are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sector expertise (not generalists)
rubrics_metrics.description: We are not generalists. Your ICR team has decades of deep expertise in your sector.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective communications and IR strategies are sector-informed; deep, sector-specific knowledge (healthcare, technology, energy, financial services, etc.) is a criterion for tailoring messaging and investor targeting.
